_comment: Context Set for QueryData / Conversational Analytics API targeting
the weatherbot narrow schema (sensors + sensor_readings + stations).
Authored following the patterns documented in the Context Engineering
references for templates, facets, and value_searches.
Upload via Cloud SQL Studio → Data Agents → Context Sets → Upload.
Then reference the resulting context-set resource name in
Iterate on this file by re-running the bootstrap / hill-climb flows
from the db-context-engineering plugin once the workflow is loaded.
The `_comment` keys are stripped by Cloud SQL Studio on upload; they
exist purely as documentation for humans reading the file.

value_searches.description: Fuzzy, case-insensitive match for the place a sensor is installed. Maps the user's spoken word ("pool", "poul", "out side") to the actual title-cased enum stored in sensors.physical_location: 'Outdoor', 'Bedroom', 'Garage', 'Pool', 'Pool (retired)'. Critical: WITHOUT this, the planner emits `WHERE physical_location = 'pool'` (lowercase) and silently returns zero rows.
value_searches.query: WITH TrigramMetrics AS (SELECT T."physical_location" AS original_value, (T."physical_location" <-> $value::text) AS normalized_dist FROM "sensors" T WHERE T."physical_location" % $value::text) SELECT original_value AS value, 'sensors.physical_location' AS columns, 'Sensor Location' AS concept_type, normalized_dist AS distance, ''::text AS context FROM TrigramMetrics

value_searches.description: Fuzzy match for what kind of reading the user wants. Maps colloquial words ('temp', 'temperature', 'humid', 'rain', 'wind speed', 'wind gust') to the canonical snake_case enum stored in sensors.measurement_type. Valid values: temperature, humidity, dew_point, feels_like, wind_speed, wind_gust, wind_direction, pressure, rain_rate, rain_total, solar_radiation, uv_index, pm25, aqi, battery.
value_searches.query: WITH TrigramMetrics AS (SELECT T."measurement_type" AS original_value, (T."measurement_type" <-> $value::text) AS normalized_dist FROM "sensors" T WHERE T."measurement_type" % $value::text) SELECT original_value AS value, 'sensors.measurement_type' AS columns, 'Measurement Type' AS concept_type, normalized_dist AS distance, ''::text AS context FROM TrigramMetrics

value_searches.description: Fuzzy match against the human-friendly sensor name (e.g. 'Pool temperature', 'Outdoor humidity', 'Bedroom dew point'). Useful when the user names a specific reading rather than a location + measurement type. Backed by a GiST trigram index on sensors.display_name.
value_searches.query: WITH TrigramMetrics AS (SELECT T."display_name" AS original_value, (T."display_name" <-> $value::text) AS normalized_dist FROM "sensors" T WHERE T."display_name" % $value::text) SELECT original_value AS value, 'sensors.display_name' AS columns, 'Sensor Display Name' AS concept_type, normalized_dist AS distance, ''::text AS context FROM TrigramMetrics

templates.sql: SELECT s.display_name, s.unit, lr.observed_at, lr.value FROM sensors s JOIN LATERAL (SELECT observed_at, value FROM sensor_readings r WHERE r.sensor_id = s.sensor_id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) lr ON true WHERE s.physical_location = 'Pool' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.is_active = true AND s.reliable = true
templates.manifest: What's the current temperature at a given location?

parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT s.display_name, s.unit, lr.observed_at, lr.value FROM sensors s JOIN LATERAL (SELECT observed_at, value FROM sensor_readings r WHERE r.sensor_id = s.sensor_id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) lr ON true WHERE s.physical_location = $1 AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.is_active = true AND s.reliable = true

templates.nl_query: What was the highest pool temperature in the last two weeks?
templates.sql: SELECT max(r.value) AS max_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Pool' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY s.unit
templates.intent: What was the highest pool temperature in the last 14 days?
templates.manifest: What was the highest temperature at a given location in the last a given number of days?

parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT max(r.value) AS max_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id WHERE s.physical_location = $1 AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= now() - ($2 * interval '1 day') GROUP BY s.unit
parameterized.parameterized_intent: What was the highest temperature at $1 in the last $2 days?

templates.nl_query: Count of days in the last two weeks when the pool temperature was over 90
templates.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date) AS day_count FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Pool' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.value > 90 AND r.observed_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
templates.intent: On how many calendar days in the last 14 days did the pool temperature exceed 90 degrees?
templates.manifest: On how many calendar days in the last a given number of days did the temperature at a given location exceed a given number degrees?

parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date) AS day_count FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = $1 AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.value > $2 AND r.observed_at >= now() - ($3 * interval '1 day')
parameterized.parameterized_intent: On how many calendar days in the last $3 days did the temperature at $1 exceed $2 degrees?

templates.nl_query: What was the lowest outdoor temperature yesterday?
templates.sql: SELECT min(r.value) AS min_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Outdoor' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date - 1 GROUP BY s.unit
templates.intent: What was the lowest outdoor temperature yesterday?
templates.manifest: What was the lowest temperature at a given location on a given date?

parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT min(r.value) AS min_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = $1 AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date = $2::date GROUP BY s.unit
parameterized.parameterized_intent: What was the lowest temperature at $1 on $2?

templates.nl_query: Pool temperature hourly averages for the last 24 hours
templates.sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) AS hour_local, avg(r.value) AS avg_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Pool' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, s.unit ORDER BY 1
templates.intent: Pool temperature hourly averages for the last 24 hours
templates.manifest: Hourly averages of temperature at a given location for the last a given number of hours

parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) AS hour_local, avg(r.value) AS avg_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = $1 AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= now() - ($2 * interval '1 hour') GROUP BY 1, s.unit ORDER BY 1
parameterized.parameterized_intent: Hourly averages of temperature at $1 for the last $2 hours

templates.sql: SELECT avg(r.value) AS avg_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Outdoor' AND s.measurement_type = 'humidity' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) >= date_trunc('week', (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)) - interval '7 days' AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) <  date_trunc('week', (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)) GROUP BY s.unit
templates.intent: Average outdoor humidity last week (previous Monday–Sunday in local time)
templates.manifest: Average a given measurement type at a given location last week (previous Monday–Sunday in local time)

parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT avg(r.value) AS avg_value, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = $1 AND s.measurement_type = $2 AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) >= date_trunc('week', (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)) - interval '7 days' AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) <  date_trunc('week', (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)) GROUP BY s.unit
parameterized.parameterized_intent: Average $2 at $1 last week (previous Monday–Sunday in local time)

templates.nl_query: Peak wind gust over the last 30 days
templates.sql: SELECT max(r.value) AS peak_value, s.unit, (max(r.observed_at) AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) AS occurred_at_local FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.measurement_type = 'wind_gust' AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY s.unit, st.timezone
templates.intent: Peak wind gust over the last 30 days
templates.manifest: Peak a given measurement type over the last a given number of days

parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT max(r.value) AS peak_value, s.unit, (max(r.observed_at) AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) AS occurred_at_local FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.measurement_type = $1 AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= now() - ($2 * interval '1 day') GROUP BY s.unit, st.timezone
